description: Copernicus Emergency Management Service activations for Uganda (4 activations, on the JRC data catalogue) is a series of data sets listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by European Commission, Joint Research Centre. Activation time (UTC): 2020-05-15 12:42:00 Event time (UTC): 2020-05-09 00:00:00 Event type: Flood (Riverine flood) Activation reason: Torrential rains have triggered devastating floods and landslides across East Africa in recent weeks, aggravating an already challenging situation as countries in the region battle the coronavirus pandemic. Coverage: Uganda. The portal lists 4 near-identical data sets in this series (one per event, year, area or country), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher European Commission, Joint Research Centre. Its tags are Science and technology, Regions and cities, CEMS, Copernicus, Copernicus Emergency Management Service. The repository dates the deposit 2026; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (data set page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
